articles.titleTr: Petrolde sınırlı rahatlama: ABD stokları arttı, Hürmüz'deki riskler devam etti
articles.summaryTr: ABD'de ham petrol ve yakıt stoklarının yükselmesi, küresel arzın toparlanabileceği beklentileriyle petrol fiyatlarını aşağı çekti. Ham petrolün varil fiyatı aşağı yönlü seyrini sürdürürken, ABD-İran çatışmasının Hürmüz Boğazı'ndaki sevkiyatları tehdit etmesi kayıpları sınırladı.
articles.articleText: Petrolde sınırlı rahatlama: ABD stokları arttı, Hürmüz'deki riskler devam etti ABD'de ham petrol ve yakıt stoklarının yükselmesi, küresel arzın toparlanabileceği beklentileriyle petrol fiyatlarını aşağı çekti. Ham petrolün varil fiyatı aşağı yönlü seyrini sürdürürken, ABD-İran çatışmasının Hürmüz Boğazı'ndaki sevkiyatları tehdit etmesi kayıpları sınırladı. Petrol fiyatları aşağı çekildi Petrol fiyatları, ABD'de ham petrol ve yakıt stoklarının geçen hafta arttığını gösteren verilerin ardından düşüşünü sürdürdü. WTI ham petrol vadeli işlemleri TSİ 07.49 itibarıyla yüzde 0,65 gerileyerek varil başına 85,45 dolara indi. Brent petrol vadeli işlemleri de yüzde 0,17 düşüşle 92,98 dolardan işlem gördü. ABD'nin ham petrol ve benzin stokları yükseldi Amerikan Petrol Enstitüsü (API) verilerine göre, 13 Kasım'da sona eren haftada ABD'nin ham petrol stokları 5,28 milyon varil arttı. Aynı dönemde benzin stoklarında 5,12 milyon varil, damıtılmış yakıt stoklarında ise 351 bin varil artış kaydedildi. Yemen'deki İran destekli Husi milisleri, salı günü Suudi Arabistan'ın Doğu-Batı petrol boru hattı üzerindeki iki pompa istasyonuna beş insansız hava aracı fırlattıklarını açıkladı. Suudi Arabistan, savaş sürecinde petrol sevkiyatını Hürmüz Boğazı dışına yönlendirmek amacıyla söz konusu hattı kullanarak ham petrolü Yanbu Limanı'na taşıyor. Keşm adasına saldırı ABD ile İran arasındaki karşılıklı saldırılar ve Hürmüz Boğazı'ndan geçen gemilere yönelik riskler, petrol fiyatlarındaki düşüşü sınırladı. ABD ordusu, İran'ın bölgedeki ABD personeli ve varlıklarına yönelik saldırılarının ardından salı günü Kişm Adası'ndaki bir füze fırlatma üssünü hedef aldı. Üçüncü bir ABD uçak gemisinin Körfez'e ulaşmasıyla İran, ABD güçlerine ve ticari gemilere yönelik tehditlerini artırdı. Bahreyn Savunma Kuvvetleri de çarşamba günü, ABD Donanması Beşinci Filosu'na ev sahipliği yapan ülkeye yönelik İran hava saldırılarının engellendiğini açıkladı. Hürmüz Boğazı'nda tanker saldırıları sürüyor Hürmüz Boğazı'ndaki deniz trafiğine yönelik güvenlik riskleri, petrol sevkiyatında aksama endişelerini artırıyor. Pazartesi günü Umman kıyılarında boğazdan geçiş yapan bir LPG tankerine bir cismin isabet etmesi üzerine mürettebat gemiyi tahliye etmek zorunda kaldı. LSEG analistleri, bölgesel petrol arzının alternatif güzergâhlar üzerinden toparlanabileceğini ancak mevcut gemi verilerinin Hürmüz Boğazı'ndaki sevkiyatın henüz normalleşmediğini gösterdiğini belirtti. İran ile arabulucu ülkeler arasındaki görüşmeler devam ediyor ABD-İran çatışmasının yoğunlaştığı süreçte İran ile arabulucu ülkeler Umman ve Katar arasındaki görüşmeler sürüyor. Karşılıklı saldırıların etkisiyle petrol fiyatları salı gününü yükselişle tamamladı. Hürmüz Boğazı'ndan geçen gemilere yönelik saldırılar da arz güvenliğine ilişkin endişeleri artırdı.

articles.titleTr: Altın ve gümüşte zaman tüneli! Fiyat Eylül 2025 seviyesine kadar gitti
articles.summaryTr: Altın, güçlü dolar karşısında ezilmeye devam ediyor. Ons altın fiyatı, 22-29 Eylül 2025 haftası seviyelerine kadar geri çekilirken Fed'den gelen şahin açıklamalar baskıyı artırıyor. Yatırımcıların gözü ise bugün açıklanacak Fed tutanaklarında.
articles.articleText: Altın ve gümüşte zaman tüneli! Fiyat Eylül 2025 seviyesine kadar gitti Altın, güçlü dolar karşısında ezilmeye devam ediyor. Ons altın fiyatı, 22-29 Eylül 2025 haftası seviyelerine kadar geri çekilirken Fed'den gelen şahin açıklamalar baskıyı artırıyor. Yatırımcıların gözü ise bugün açıklanacak Fed tutanaklarında. Altın bir yıldan uzun sürenin dibine geriledi Altın fiyatları, çarşamba günü doların güçlenmesi ve ABD'de faiz artırımı beklentilerinin etkisiyle sert düşüş kaydetti. Spot altın, TSİ 07.13 itibarıyla yüzde 1,65'in üzerinde değer kaybederek ons başına 3.796,37 dolara geriledi. Böylece değerli metal, Eylül 2025'in 3. haftasından bu yana en düşük seviyesine indi. O tarihte altın, rekor kıracağı yolculukta doğru hızlı yükseliş içindeydi. Güçlü dolar altın ve gümüşü baskıladı ABD doları, 19 ayın en yüksek seviyesine yakın seyrini korudu. Doların güçlenmesi, dolar üzerinden fiyatlandırılan altın ve gümüşü diğer para birimlerini kullanan yatırımcılar açısından daha pahalı hale getirdi. OANDA Kıdemli Piyasa Analisti Kelvin Wong, altındaki düşüşte yatırımcı duyarlılığı ve teknik faktörlerin etkili olduğunu belirtti. Wong, Fed yetkililerinden gelen şahin mesajlar ve ABD Hazine tahvil getirilerindeki yükselişin doların değer kazanmasını desteklediğini söyledi. Diğer metaller arasında, spot gümüş ons başına yüzde 2,9 düşüşle 46,01 dolara Fed'den faiz artırımı beklentisi güçlendi New York Fed Başkanı John Williams, salı günü yaptığı açıklamada, enflasyon baskılarıyla mücadele etmek amacıyla ABD Merkez Bankası'nın faiz oranlarını yeniden artırmasının gerekebileceğini söyledi. Williams, buna karşın Fed'in daha agresif bir politika izlemeye yönelmesi gerektiği görüşüne karşı çıktı. CME FedWatch verilerine göre piyasalar, aralık ayında 25 baz puanlık faiz artırımı ihtimalini yüzde 95,7 olarak fiyatlıyor. Faizin 50 baz puan artırılması olasılığı ise yüzde 4,3 seviyesinde bulunuyor. Yüksek faiz altının yatırımcılar açısından maliyetini artırıyor Faiz oranlarının yükselmesi, yatırımcısına düzenli getiri sağlamayan altını elde tutmanın fırsat maliyetini artırıyor. Bu durum, faiz getirisi sunan varlıkların cazibesini yükseltirken altın fiyatları üzerindeki baskıyı güçlendiriyor. KCM Trade Baş Piyasa Analisti Tim Waterer, piyasalardaki oynaklık nedeniyle yatırımcıların pozisyonlarını azaltarak sermayeyi başka varlıklara yönlendirdiğini ve altının yeniden bir likidite kaynağı olarak değerlendirildiğini belirtti. Piyasalar Fed tutanaklarına odaklandı Yatırımcılar, Fed'in 27-28 Ekim tarihlerinde gerçekleştirdiği Federal Açık Piyasa Komitesi (FOMC) toplantısının tutanaklarını bekliyor. TSİ 19.00'da yayımlanması beklenen tutanakların, merkez bankasının faiz politikasına ilişkin değerlendirmelerine ve gelecek döneme yönelik yaklaşımına dair ipuçları vermesi bekleniyor. Gram altın satış fiyatı, gram gümüş satış fiyatı Bu gelişmelerle ons altının küresel fiyatı ve dolar/TL kurundaki hareketliliklerin etkisine iç piyasadaki arz-talep dengesinin ve fiziki altın primlerinin de katılmasıyla oluşan gram altının alış fiyatı 6.105,66 TL, satış fiyatı 6.148,63 TL oldu. Gram gümüş satış fiyatı 74,47 TL oldu. Gram gümüş, tarihinde ilk kez 28 Kasım 2025 tarihinde 75 TL seviyesini aşmıştı.

articles.title: Jeff Bezos says he was 'heavily involved' in casting Robert Pattinson as new 007
articles.summary: The Amazon CEO said he was originally "biased against" Pattinson "because he's already so famous".
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Jeff Bezos says he was 'heavily involved' in casting Robert Pattinson as new 007
articles.summaryTr: The Amazon CEO said he was originally "biased against" Pattinson "because he's already so famous".
articles.articleText: Jeff Bezos says he was 'heavily involved' in casting Robert Pattinson as new 007 - Published Jeff Bezos has said he was "heavily involved" in casting Robert Pattinson as the new James Bond. Speaking at an event in California, the Amazon CEO said he was originally "biased against" Pattinson - who starred in many blockbuster films like Batman and the Twilight series - "because he's already so famous". The role of 007 has typically gone to an actor who is not as well-known at the time of casting. But Bezos said in screen tests, "it was so obvious he is James Bond". This will be the first 007 not under the creative control of the Broccoli family, who had overseen the franchise since the first Bond film in 1962. Amazon purchased MGM, which co-owns the franchise, in 2022. "There was something special about Rob", Bezos said at Semafor Silicon Valley & The World Event on Tuesday. Pattinson was unveiled as the franchise's seventh James Bond on Monday, taking over from actor Daniel Craig. He will star in the 26th Bond movie, due to be released in 2028. In a statement, the London-born actor said: "James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honour of a lifetime." The next Bond film will be directed by Denis Villeneuve, but its title and exact release date have not yet been announced. The announcement comes after years of intense speculation about who will take over from Craig in one of the most high-profile - and highly scrutinised - roles in entertainment. Several other actors, including Josh O'Connor, Callum Turner and Jack Lowden, were reported to be in the frame for the role as screen tests took place in recent weeks. But Amazon MGM ultimately went with a household name, choosing a more bankable movie star who is widely seen as a safe pair of hands. "We ran a really tight process and made the final decision on Friday," Bezos said. There were five finalists who went through "real, old-fashioned screen tests", acting out three different scenes in full costume, with real sets and other actors, he said. "By the time we got to this list of five, they were all amazing. But there was something special about Rob and his performance," Bezos added. "It was immediately un-debated. Denis [Villeneuve], the director … we all gravitated toward Rob." The pick comes amid widespread Hollywood cuts and consolidation, with studios struggling to get people into cinemas. Hollywood insiders have said Pattinson was viewed as a safe pick to bring audiences in, rather than taking a risk on a new actor who could grow with the franchise. "Maybe he's boring. Maybe Hollywood would be passing up a chance to anoint a badly needed new star. But with so much at stake for everyone involved, that all makes him the obvious pick," Hollywood journalist Matthew Belloni, who predicted the pick, wrote in his newsletter. The BBC's Regan Morris contributed to this report. Related topics - Published15 hours ago - Published12 hours ago

articles.titleTr: Waymo pulls driverless taxis from all US freeways
articles.summaryTr: The decision comes after California banned Waymo's driverless vehicles from operating on the state's highways following a series of traffic incidents.
articles.articleText: Waymo pulls driverless taxis from all US freeways - Published Waymo has temporarily suspended its driverless vehicles from operating on all US freeways, the company has said. The decision comes after California banned Waymo's driverless taxis from state freeways following a series of recent traffic incidents. California's Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) cited an "imminent hazard to public safety" for the ban, noting an incident this month in which several driverless Waymo vehicles entered an active construction zone on US Route 101. Waymo said it was working with state officials "diligently and responsibly to resume freeway operations", adding that no injuries or collisions were reported following the incident on US Route 101 south of San Francisco. California's DMV said Waymo's driverless taxis presented a risk "due to recurring incursions by its vehicles into active construction zones where construction workers, vehicles and equipment are present". In another incident earlier this month, footage widely seen on social media appeared to show a Waymo car trying to overtake patrol vehicles that were deliberately slowing the pace of traffic on a San Francisco highway. The California ban, which came into effect on 11 November, would remain in place until Waymo "demonstrates to the department that it has taken effective corrective actions to address the deficiencies that precipitated the restrictions". A Waymo spokesperson said: "In alignment with our safety-first principles, we have also temporarily restricted freeway operations across our other operating markets to evaluate our performance." Data on Waymo's website suggests that its cars, compared to human drivers, are involved in 95% fewer crashes resulting in serious injury. Waymo currently operates driverless taxis in 15 US cities, but only offered freeway rides in a handful of those locations, including San Francisco, Los Angeles and Miami. The company's driverless taxis can continue to operate on regular city streets. In May, Waymo recalled thousands of its self-driving cars in the US over a software issue that could allow vehicles to drive into flooded roads. In the same month, multiple Waymo cars were spotted driving around a cul-de-sac in Atlanta, Georgia, in the early hours of the morning. Related topics - Published19 June

articles.summaryTr: The AI chip giant reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday after the dramatic exit of Jensen Huang.
articles.articleText: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as firm reports bumper results - Published Nvidia's quarterly sales doubled to top $100bn for the first time as the company insisted it has no plans to reinstate ousted co-founder Jensen Huang. In the company's first results since Huang's dramatic exit, interim chief executive Colette Kress said it is "business as usual" and told investors: "We've got this." The company's quarterly sales doubled from a year earlier, reaching $115.8bn (£86.9bn), with shares in the company jumping by 4.8% in after-hours trading. Earlier on Tuesday, Huang said he would be "honoured" to return and lead Nvidia, having quit following alleged extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected spy for China. "The board does not intend to reinstate him," Nvidia chair Harvey Jones said during a call on Tuesday with financial analysts. The company's profits also doubled from a year ago. For the quarter, which covered the three months to 25 October, profit hit $65bn. Its revenue from data centres, a significant part of Nvidia's business, also doubled to $107bn in the same period. Going forward, the company said its rapid growth is poised to continue, and revenue will rise by another 13% in the next quarter. Given the uncertainty surrounding the company after Huang's exit, financial analysts had been unsure that Nvidia would provide any forward-looking guidance. Daniela Hathorn, a senior analyst for trading platform Capital.com, said Nvidia's results "offer a strong answer to concerns that demand for AI infrastructure is cooling" and temper immediate worries that Huang was irreplaceable as a leader. "The harder question is whether Nvidia can preserve the strategic advantage Huang helped build," Hathorn added. "His exit is unlikely to change orders already committed, but could matter more when Nvidia makes its next round of decisions on products, partnerships and investment." Kress seemed eager to stress that Nvidia can continue to not only succeed, but lead the ongoing AI buildout that is happening throughout the technology industry. "It is business as usual," she said. "Our partners, our suppliers, all of them are 100% behind us." She added that Nvidia's leadership team has "stood up very strongly over the last week... working seamlessly in all of their departments and projects". "Our momentum is real. Our demand is accelerating. Our supply is growing. Our customers and our partners are with us, and employees are committed." Kress said before leaving the analyst call. "We've got this." The interim CEO also said Nvidia is no longer shipping Hopper data centre semiconductors to China. The Hopper technology is in Nvidia's advanced H200 processors, which the firm won approval to sell in China after Huang's repeated lobbying efforts in Washington. They had previously been restricted over concerns that selling them to China would give its industries and military an edge over the US. Kress did not elaborate on why the shipments had been stopped. Despite board chairman Jones saying earlier that the company would not answer analysts' questions about Huang or Nvidia's investigation into his conduct, he did address the search for a permanent replacement. He said Nvidia is working with an executive search firm and is considering internal and external candidates, but that the company would not rush its selection. "With the advanced technology and the national security dynamics in the marketplace, our new CEO will have to navigate those waters carefully," Jones said. "The search will be thorough and we want to do it as quickly as possible, but we won't do it before we find the exact right person." Michael Monaghan from investment firm Founder ETFs is among those who want Huang back in the top job at Nvidia. The Nvidia investor told the BBC that he is waiting to see the results of a thorough investigation into Huang's actions, instead of relying on "salacious allegations" made in the media. Nvidia's strong earnings are "from the machine that Jensen built" and a company tends to lose "its shine and vision" after an iconic founder leaves, Monaghan said. articles.title: Europe plans to catch the next computer chip wave
articles.summary: Europe hopes to be a leader in a new generation of computer chips which use light to process data.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Europe plans to catch the next computer chip wave
articles.summaryTr: Europe hopes to be a leader in a new generation of computer chips which use light to process data.
articles.articleText: Europe plans to catch the next computer chip wave - Published "Photonic chips are on the verge of a breakthrough," says Ton van Mol of the Dutch research institute TNO. If van Mol is right – and TNO, the European Union and the Dutch government are backing the idea with millions of euros - then the technology could be a gamechanger. The chips which run today's society, from your phone and TV, to the vast data centres meeting our insatiable desire for AI, are mostly electrical. They process data by shunting electrons around tiny circuits – a single microchip produced today can contain billions of transistors, and sizes are measured in nanometres (one nanometre is a billionth of a metre). Because they use light instead of electricity, photonic chips are faster, use less energy and generate less heat than traditional computer chips. Van Mol hopes for an acceleration in photonics similar to the one seen in electrical chips since the 1970s. "With optical chips, you are now where electronic chips were maybe 40 [or] 50 years ago." American, Taiwanese and Chinese firms dominate the computer chip industry, but Europe sees the emergence of photonic chips as a fresh opportunity to lead, on what could be, a key future technology. Which is why the European Union has committed €400m ($450m; £330m) to a project called PIX Europe, external, with the stated goal of making the continent "a global leader in emerging technology for Photonic Integrated Chips". "Europe said 'we need to have our own manufacturing in-house'," says van Mol, who is leading a key part of the programme. "We cannot depend like in the past that everything is manufactured in the US or China - that's not wise, so the [European] Chips Act was called into life, and one of the parts of the act is to build pilot lines to really bring the technology, which is now in labs, to the next stage - manufacturing." 'Really serious' development Electronic and photonic chips are produced on wafers made up of hundreds of individual chips. Factories with machines that can handle bigger wafers can churn out chips more efficiently. "[Photonic chip] manufacturing worldwide is [currently] done on wafers which are four inches (10cm) in size, and the next step is to scale-up production to a six-inch wafer," says van Mol. His team are already building a 10,000 sq m factory to produce six-inch indium phosphide wafers on the High Tech Campus in the Dutch city of Eindhoven. It's due to fully open in 2030 and will be a major step forward, not just for photonics in Europe, but around the world, according to van Mol. "That's the development TNO is going to do, in a pilot line which is really serious. "In 2030, we hope that we have a stable, reproducible, high-yield process, and then the intention is that the pilot line [opens] to industrial parties who can make commercial production out of it." Europe does have one crucial player in the current computer chip industry - ASML. The Netherlands-based tech giant is the only company in the world able to build the machines needed to make the most sophisticated semiconductors. Which is why ASML products will sit at the heart of the pilot line in Eindhoven - it's no coincidence that van Mol's project is based around the corner from ASML's headquarters. "The way you produce these [photonic] chips is very similar to the way you produce electrical or electronic chip," says van Mol. "You use the same type of equipment, you also need a high-end clean room, you also use wafers, so the production method is very similar to the traditional semiconductor technology." ASML itself is keen to explore the opportunities that the emerging technology of photonics could offer. "Europe has a strong position in photonics research. The next challenge is translating those innovations into industrial-scale manufacturing," says Stanislas Baron, who is the head of ASML's EU/US Customer Team. ASML's unique success has helped build an influential and lucrative network of companies and institutions devoted to semiconductor technology in and around Eindhoven, and it's a model for what Europe is trying to achieve with photonic chips. The Eindhoven project has the backing of former ASML chief executive Peter Wennink, author of an influential report for the Dutch government called The Roadmap to Future Prosperity, external, which noted that the market for photonics was expected to grow 10 to 20 times in the next 10 years. In a news release backing the new pilot line, Wennink described it as "a launchpad for Europe's future digital economy". "By investing in scalable production capacity, we are creating an ecosystem that can help shape the global technological direction," he said. Of course, Europe is not alone in looking to the potential of photonics to earn a global economic advantage. In June this year, US photonics company Coherent, external announced what it called "the world's first and largest volume-production six-inch indium phosphide manufacturing platform" at its plant in Sherman, in Texas. The expansion is backed by chip manufacturing giant Nvidia, as well as $50 million public funds under the US Chips Act. It's an illustration of how quickly the market is moving, and how central photonic chips could be to the continuing race to retain an influential stake in AI and technological development more generally. Europe's bid to establish itself as a global leader in photonic chips – exemplified by the Eindhoven project – is the kind of strategy that makes sense in a globalised economy, says Joris Teer, policy analyst at the European Institute for Security Studies in Brussels. If the continent can take a lead in photonic chips, then future developments in AI and data will partly be dependent on Europe. "Europe knows that its high energy and labour costs, skilled workforce shortages, and lack of private and public capital make an across-the-board reindustrialisation strategy impossible", Teer says. "To retain influence, ensuring dependence on European parties rather than European autonomy is key." Once up and running, the Eindhoven project will provide a pilot production line which can be used multiple companies. It will be open to businesses across Europe and beyond, who can design and build chips without having to develop their own expensive production facilities. "What we want to establish here is what we call a foundry model; there's no intention to have our own product," Ton van Mol says. Instead, they will produce to order for outside customers. It's the same idea which, at huge scale, has brought Taiwanese-based giant TSMC a position of global dominance in the manufacture of microchips. Photonic chips are already in use, in highly specialised areas in data centres and in Lidar (light detection and ranging) sensor technology, for instance. For van Mol of TNO, helping the industry to scale up, by easing production challenges and increasing capacity, is the key step to moving them into the tech we use in our daily lives, like phones and laptops, and to drive innovation in areas like medical scanners and 6G communications. "The demand is there", says van Mol, "and the end goal is to have, in Europe, manufacturing of these chips, which is strategically very important because these chips [could] become the backbone of all data and telecom." articles.summaryTr: Bankacılık Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurulu, Adil Katılım Bankası A.Ş.'nin temettü dışındaki ortaklık hakları ile yönetim ve denetimini Tasarruf Mevduatı Sigorta Fonu'na devretti. Karar 18 Kasım tarihli Resmî Gazete'de yayımlandı.
articles.articleText: Adil Katılım Bankası'nın faaliyet izni iptal edildi: Temettü dışındaki haklar TMSF'ye devredildi YAYIN TARİHİ, 18 Kasım 2026 02:06 PAYLAŞ - Bankacılık Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurulu, Adil Katılım Bankası A.Ş.'nin temettü dışındaki ortaklık hakları ile yönetim ve denetimini Tasarruf Mevduatı Sigorta Fonu'na devretti. Karar 18 Kasım tarihli Resmî Gazete'de yayımlandı. Bankacılık Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurulu (BDDK), Adil Katılım Bankası A.Ş. hakkında karar aldı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 18 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmî Gazete'de yayımlanan 11601 sayılı Kurul Kararı'na göre bankanın temettü dışındaki ortaklık hakları ile yönetim ve denetimi Tasarruf Mevduatı Sigorta Fonu'na (TMSF) devredildi. Karar, BDDK'nın 17 Kasım 2026 tarihli toplantısında yapılan inceleme ve değerlendirmelerin ardından alındı. Karar Bankacılık Kanunu'na dayandırıldı Kurul kararında, Adil Katılım Bankası'nın temettü dışındaki ortaklık hakları ile yönetim ve denetiminin 5411 sayılı Bankacılık Kanunu'nun 71'inci maddesinin birinci fıkrasının (a), (c) ve (d) bentleri kapsamında TMSF'ye devredilmesine hükmedildi. Karar, 18 Kasım 2026 tarihinde yayımlanarak duyuruldu.

articles.titleTr: As Trump and Xi meet, China's AI dreams face an unexpected hurdle: the Nvidia spy scandal
articles.summaryTr: China worries the scandal could ramp up pressure on the US to further restrict the sale of advanced chips.
articles.articleText: As Trump and Xi meet, China's AI dreams face an unexpected hurdle: the Nvidia spy scandal - Published Jensen Huang is out but his shadow looms over the upcoming meeting between US President Donald Trump and his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping this week. For Beijing, the former Nvidia CEO's dramatic fall is a major challenge - and not just because of claims that a Chinese spy may have honey-trapped Huang, one of the artificial intelligence industry's most influential figures. Rather, the allegations surrounding Huang and his affair with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang are turning into a new flashpoint in an already fragile US-China relationship. US intelligence reports claim she had ties to Beijing's intelligence apparatus - in particular the Ministry of State Security, China's main civilian spy agency. The claim remains unproven, but it has already reignited debate in Washington over exports of advanced chips to China and whether the Trump administration has been too willing to ease restrictions. For years now, advanced computer chips have been a key battleground in the US-China rivalry because they are essential for AI, supercomputing and military technology. Chinese officials are worried this scandal could strengthen voices in Washington who argue in favour of further limiting Chinese access to cutting-edge American tech. Just this week, the Trump administration introduced new export restrictions on Chinese firms that access advanced US chips in third countries such as Malaysia, Thailand or Brazil. They typically do this by renting computing power in data centres abroad to train their AI models. But some of the firms, like the one Alice Huang worked for, are also accused of smuggling chips to China, although they have denied this. Until now, this controversy appeared to be a sideshow in US-China relations. But with Beijing calling the new rules "economic coercion" on the eve of Trump arriving in Shenzhen, there is a growing risk it could become something much bigger. Democrats, who will control Congress come January, have made their position clear. Last Wednesday top Democrat Ted Lieu told Politico the Trump administration had been "1,000%" too deferential to Nvidia, putting national security at risk, while fellow Democrat Zoe Lofgren suggested Congress would now be more likely to restrict sales of AI chips to China. The BBC has approached the White House for comment. Beijing's foreign ministry had described the spy claims as a "smear against China". "The US should stop fabricating so-called espionage narratives to find pretexts for imposing technological blockades," spokesperson Mao Ning said last week. The ministry also seemed keen to keep the meeting on track, saying the two countries had kept "close communication regarding interactions between the two heads of state". Another 'spy balloon' incident? For the last year, Trump and Xi have been seeking to stabilise relations after a damaging tariff war that almost brought trade between the two countries to a standstill. The Trump administration's decision to permit sales of advanced Nvidia H200 chips to China in late 2025 was seen as evidence that both sides were searching for areas of co-operation, even while competition intensified. It was a rare move given Washington had spent years trying to limit China's access to the most advanced chips. Many in the US have long viewed these chips as a national security issue, arguing they could strengthen China's military and surveillance capabilities. Jensen Huang, who rejects that claim, advocated lifting bans on the export of high-performing chips to China. Beijing argues the restrictions are an attempt to contain its rise. Now that opening may be under threat. History has taught Beijing and Washington that spy scandals rarely remain confined to the intelligence world. Analysts in China already see echoes of an incident in 2023 when a suspected surveillance balloon drifted through the skies over the US before an American fighter jet shot it down. Beijing insisted it was a civilian meteorological airship that had strayed off course. But a planned trip by then US Secretary of State Antony Blinken was cancelled and communication between the two governments deteriorated sharply. The incident showed how quickly a security dispute could overwhelm diplomatic efforts and push relations into a deep freeze. "The mere passage of a balloon sent American public opinion and politicians into a state of high alert, as if a "Chinese threat" were looming directly overhead," said the state media outlet, the Global Times this week as it made a direct comparison with the Nvidia scandal. "No-one on the US side has ever apologised or taken responsibility for the genuine damage this caused to US-China relations," it added. The state-run outlet also questioned why the Nvidia story had emerged so soon after "the hard-won detente" between Beijing and Washington, following a meeting between the two countries' leaders in September. "Is someone behind the scenes pushing an agenda and stirring up confrontation?" it asked. Trump-Xi summit unlikely to collapse Both Trump and Xi have significant incentives to keep talking. China's economy remains under pressure and is increasingly reliant on exports. Xi needs trade to keep flowing and this meeting is a key stepping stone to replacing the current trade truce that is due to expire in January. Meanwhile Trump has repeatedly touted his close relationship with Xi and argued that maintaining dialogue is essential to managing competition between the two powers. The US president is in his last two years and faces an uphill struggle to pass domestic legislation after the midterms. To counter this, he could be looking for some foreign policy wins. He may also hope for Xi's help to end the war in the Middle East. Neither side will want to be discussing intelligence concerns and technology controls instead of trade, investment and economic co-operation. The summit is also being carefully choreographed by Beijing to show off its technological prowess in Shenzhen - a deeply symbolic choice of city. It's home to some of the country's biggest tech companies and has become a showcase for Beijing's ambitions in AI and advanced manufacturing. Also, given Washington's tighter restrictions on advanced chips, Beijing has options for retaliation. One of its most powerful tools is its dominance of key rare earth minerals. China processes much of the world's supply for materials that are used in everything from electric vehicles and smartphones to military equipment. Analysts have long warned that technological restrictions can trigger a cycle of retaliation in which each side reaches for its strongest economic leverage. That would shift the current trend of US-China relations from engagement back towards mutual suspicion. - Published14 hours ago - Published5 days ago

articles.title: Türkiye'de yatırım yapan yabancılara 5 yıllık ikamet izni: Alt sınır 150 bin dolar
articles.summary: Türkiye'de yatırım yapacak yabancılara yatırım tutarına göre 3 veya 5 yıl süreli ikamet izni verilecek. En az 150 bin dolar yatırım yapanlar 3 yıl, 200 bin dolar yatırım yapanlar ise 5 yıllık ikamet izni alabilecek.

articles.titleTr: Türkiye'de yatırım yapan yabancılara 5 yıllık ikamet izni: Alt sınır 150 bin dolar
articles.summaryTr: Türkiye'de yatırım yapacak yabancılara yatırım tutarına göre 3 veya 5 yıl süreli ikamet izni verilecek. En az 150 bin dolar yatırım yapanlar 3 yıl, 200 bin dolar yatırım yapanlar ise 5 yıllık ikamet izni alabilecek.
articles.articleText: Türkiye'de yatırım yapan yabancılara 5 yıllık ikamet izni: Alt sınır 150 bin dolar - Türkiye'de yatırım yapacak yabancılara yatırım tutarına göre 3 veya 5 yıl süreli ikamet izni verilecek. En az 150 bin dolar yatırım yapanlar 3 yıl, 200 bin dolar yatırım yapanlar ise 5 yıllık ikamet izni alabilecek. Türkiye'de yatırım yapmayı planlayan yabancılar için yeni ikamet izni düzenlemesi yürürlüğe girdi. Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan'ın imzasıyla Resmî Gazete'de yayımlanan karara göre, belirli yatırım koşullarını karşılayan yabancı yatırımcılara yatırım tutarlarına bağlı olarak 3 veya 5 yıl süreli ikamet izni verilebilecek. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Düzenleme kapsamında en az 150 bin ABD doları veya karşılığı döviz tutarında yatırım yapan yabancılara 3 yıl süreli ikamet izni düzenlenebilecek. Yatırım tutarının en az 200 bin ABD dolarına veya karşılığı döviz miktarına ulaşması halinde ise ikamet izni süresi 5 yıl olacak. Hangi yatırımlar ikamet izni kapsamında? Kararda, ikamet izni için kabul edilecek yatırım türleri de belirlendi. Buna göre yabancı yatırımcıların aşağıdaki araçlardan biri üzerinden yatırım yapması gerekiyor: - Mevduat: Türkiye'de faaliyet gösteren bankalardaki mevduat hesapları. - Devlet borçlanma araçları: Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığınca ihraç edilen devlet borçlanma araçları. - Gayrimenkul yatırım fonları: Gayrimenkul yatırım fonu katılma payları. - Girişim sermayesi fonları: Girişim sermayesi yatırım fonu katılma payları. - Emeklilik planları: Sigortacılık ve Özel Emeklilik Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurumu tarafından belirlenen emeklilik planlarına dahil olma. Yatırımın uygunluğu, tercih edilen yatırım aracına göre ilgili banka veya kamu kurumu tarafından tespit edilecek. Yatırımın en az yarısı kadar süre korunması gerekecek Düzenlemede dikkat çeken şartlardan biri de yatırımın korunma süresi oldu. Yabancı yatırımcıların gerçekleştirdikleri yatırımları, aldıkları ikamet izninin toplam süresinin en az yarısı boyunca muhafaza etmesi gerekecek. Buna göre 3 yıllık ikamet izni alanların yatırımlarını en az 1,5 yıl, 5 yıllık ikamet izni alanların ise en az 2,5 yıl boyunca koruması gerekecek. Bu koşulun sağlanıp sağlanmadığı, yatırımın türüne göre yetkili banka veya ilgili düzenleyici kurum tarafından kontrol edilecek. Başvuru şartlarını İçişleri Bakanlığı belirleyecek Yeni uygulama kapsamında yabancı yatırımcılara sunulacak hizmetler ve başvuru işlemlerine ilişkin usul ve esaslar İçişleri Bakanlığı tarafından belirlenecek. Karar kapsamında düzenlenecek ikamet izinleri, Türk Vatandaşlığı Kanunu'nun 12'nci maddesi çerçevesinde değerlendirilmeyecek. Dolayısıyla bu düzenleme doğrudan vatandaşlık hakkı sağlamıyor. Cumhurbaşkanı Kararı, 18 Kasım 2026 tarihinde Resmî Gazete'de yayımlanarak yürürlüğe girdi.

articles.title: 7 ülkeden iplik ithalatına 5 yıl daha damping vergisi: Oranlar belli oldu
articles.summary: Çin, Hindistan, Endonezya ve 4 ülkeden sentetik iplik ithalatına uygulanan dampinge karşı önlemler 5 yıl daha devam edecek. Ticaret Bakanlığı, ülke ve firmalara göre değişen vergi oranlarını açıkladı.

articles.summaryTr: Çin, Hindistan, Endonezya ve 4 ülkeden sentetik iplik ithalatına uygulanan dampinge karşı önlemler 5 yıl daha devam edecek. Ticaret Bakanlığı, ülke ve firmalara göre değişen vergi oranlarını açıkladı.
articles.articleText: 7 ülkeden iplik ithalatına 5 yıl daha damping vergisi: Oranlar belli oldu - Çin, Hindistan, Endonezya ve 4 ülkeden sentetik iplik ithalatına uygulanan dampinge karşı önlemler 5 yıl daha devam edecek. Ticaret Bakanlığı, ülke ve firmalara göre değişen vergi oranlarını açıkladı. Ticaret Bakanlığı, Çin, Endonezya, Hindistan, Malezya, Pakistan, Tayland ve Vietnam menşeli sentetik veya suni devamsız liflerden ipliklerin ithalatına yönelik dampinge karşı önlemlerin devam etmesine karar verdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 18 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmî Gazete'de yayımlanan 2026/32 sayılı Tebliğ ile söz konusu ülkelerden yapılan kesik elyaf ipliği ithalatına uygulanan mevcut önlemler 5 yıl daha yürürlükte kalacak. Karar, Bakanlığın yürüttüğü nihai gözden geçirme soruşturmasının tamamlanmasının ardından alındı. Soruşturma sonucunda, önlemlerin kaldırılması halinde damping ve yerli üretim sektöründe oluşan zararın devam etmesinin veya yeniden ortaya çıkmasının muhtemel olduğu tespit edildi. Vergiler ülkeye ve firmaya göre değişiyor Dampinge karşı önlemler, ürünün menşe ülkesi ve üretici firmaya göre farklı oranlarda uygulanacak. Bazı ülkelerde kilogram başına dolar tutarı, bazılarında ise CIF bedeli üzerinden yüzde olarak hesaplama yapılacak. Tebliğde öne çıkan oranlar şöyle: Malezya'da Penfabric için yüzde 17,03, Recron için yüzde 11,26; Pakistan'da Din Textile Mills için yüzde 10,02, Margalla ve Monnoowal Textile Mills için yüzde 6,62 oranları belirlendi. Tayland'da Indo-Thai Synthetic için yüzde 7,79, Lucky Spinning için yüzde 14,02 oranında önlem uygulanacak. Vietnam'da ise firma bazında yüzde 19,48 ile yüzde 23,91 arasında değişen oranlar yer alıyor. İthalatta 5 yıllık yeni dönem başladı Tebliğ kapsamında belirlenen dampinge karşı önlemler, yayımlandığı 18 Kasım 2026 tarihinde yürürlüğe girdi. Gümrük idareleri, kapsamdaki ürünlerin serbest dolaşıma giriş rejimi çerçevesindeki ithalatında belirlenen tutar ve oranlarda kesin önlem tahsil edecek. Düzenlemeye göre önlemler, yürürlük tarihinden itibaren 5 yıl sonra sona erecek. Ancak süre dolmadan yeni bir nihai gözden geçirme soruşturması başlatılması halinde önlemler, soruşturma tamamlanana kadar uygulanmaya devam edecek. Karar, sentetik ve suni devamsız liflerden iplik ithalatında mevcut ticaret önlemlerinin korunmasını sağlayacak.

Soruşturma sonucunda, önlemlerin kaldırılması halinde damping ve yerli üretim sektöründe oluşan zararın devam etmesinin veya yeniden ortaya çıkmasının muhtemel olduğu tespit edildi. Vergiler ülkeye ve firmaya göre değişiyor Dampinge karşı önlemler, ürünün menşe ülkesi ve üretici firmaya göre farklı oranlarda uygulanacak. Bazı ülkelerde kilogram başına dolar tutarı, bazılarında ise CIF bedeli üzerinden yüzde olarak hesaplama yapılacak. Tebliğde öne çıkan oranlar şöyle: Malezya'da Penfabric için yüzde 17,03, Recron için yüzde 11,26; Pakistan'da Din Textile Mills için yüzde 10,02, Margalla ve Monnoowal Textile Mills için yüzde 6,62 oranları belirlendi. Tayland'da Indo-Thai Synthetic için yüzde 7,79, Lucky Spinning için yüzde 14,02 oranında önlem uygulanacak. Vietnam'da ise firma bazında yüzde 19,48 ile yüzde 23,91 arasında değişen oranlar yer alıyor. İthalatta 5 yıllık yeni dönem başladı Tebliğ kapsamında belirlenen dampinge karşı önlemler, yayımlandığı 18 Kasım 2026 tarihinde yürürlüğe girdi. Gümrük idareleri, kapsamdaki ürünlerin serbest dolaşıma giriş rejimi çerçevesindeki ithalatında belirlenen tutar ve oranlarda kesin önlem tahsil edecek. Düzenlemeye göre önlemler, yürürlük tarihinden itibaren 5 yıl sonra sona erecek. Ancak süre dolmadan yeni bir nihai gözden geçirme soruşturması başlatılması halinde önlemler, soruşturma tamamlanana kadar uygulanmaya devam edecek. Karar, sentetik ve suni devamsız liflerden iplik ithalatında mevcut ticaret önlemlerinin korunmasını sağlayacak.

articles.articleText: American soldier arrested by UK police on suspicion of spying taken into US military custody - Published A US Army officer arrested in the UK on suspicion of spying for Russia earlier this month has been taken into US military custody, British counter-terror police have said. The serviceman has been identified as Lt Col Brandon Carroll Tyner, BBC News understands. The 41-year-old - who served in the US Army since 2008 - was arrested near Gloucester last week by British counter-terror police. Tyner was based at Imjin Barracks in Innsworth, Gloucestershire, the headquarters of Nato's Allied Rapid Reaction Corps. Counter Terrorism Policing said he is now in US custody over suspected national security and espionage allegations. At the time of his arrest, Russia said it had "nothing to do with it". British police previously said he was being held in London after he was arrested under section one and section three of the National Security Act 2023, which relate to obtaining or disclosing protected information, and assisting a foreign intelligence service. The day after Tyner's arrest on 10 November, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said he was "unaware" of what it was connected to. "We have nothing to do with it, and it has nothing to do with us," he told reporters in Moscow. On Tuesday, Assistant Commissioner Laurence Taylor, head of Counter Terrorism Policing, said: "Subsequently, a decision was made to pass the investigation to them [their American partners] to progress." "These are extremely serious allegations, and our collective response should send a strong message that we will act swiftly and robustly where we suspect this kind of espionage activity taking place," he added. Tyner's arrest was the result of a long-running operation by MI5 - the UK's domestic intelligence and security agency - in collaboration with the FBI, the BBC understands. He had previously served in Afghanistan and Iraq, but at the time of his arrest was working with NATO's Allied Rapid Reaction Corps near Gloucester - where he was said to be entrusted with sensitive information which would have been extremely damaging if leaked to Russia. Detectives sent the Crown Prosecution Service a file on the senior US soldier's alleged spying for consideration - allegations described by the head of Counter Terrorism Policing as "extremely serious." But at that stage the Attorney General's Office in London got involved. As did the US authorities. And now the decision has been taken that Lieutenant Colonel Tyner should be taken into custody by the US Military. It means he will not stand trial in the UK, but under US Uniform Code of Military Justice. FBI director Kash Patel said an army officer was in custody "as the result of an espionage investigation and the close cooperation" between the bureau, US Army and various UK partners. "Together we worked to identify a potential threat to national security and take swift action," he said. "This FBI has zero tolerance for anyone who betrays their oath to the United States or puts our national security at risk." US Brig Gen Sean Stinchon said the case should serve as a "stark warning to any service member suspected of violating the oath" they all take. "Whenever we suspect somebody of betraying the trust of their fellow soldiers and jeopardising our collective defence, we will identify you, and we will ensure justice is served," he added. articles.titleTr: Huang'ın ayrılığı sonrası kriz büyüyor: SEC, Nvidia'ya soruşturma başlattı
articles.summaryTr: ABD Menkul Kıymetler ve Borsa Komisyonu'nun (SEC), yatırımcıların yanıltılıp yanıltılmadığını belirlemek amacıyla Nvidia hakkında sivil soruşturma başlattığı öne sürüldü. İddia, Jensen Huang'ın CEO'luktan ayrılmasının ardından şirket üzerindeki baskıyı artırdı.
articles.articleText: Huang'ın ayrılığı sonrası kriz büyüyor: SEC, Nvidia'ya soruşturma başlattı - ABD Menkul Kıymetler ve Borsa Komisyonu'nun (SEC), yatırımcıların yanıltılıp yanıltılmadığını belirlemek amacıyla Nvidia hakkında sivil soruşturma başlattığı öne sürüldü. İddia, Jensen Huang'ın CEO'luktan ayrılmasının ardından şirket üzerindeki baskıyı artırdı. ABD'li çip üreticisi Nvidia, CEO Jensen Huang'ın ayrılığının ardından yeni bir soruşturma iddiasıyla gündeme geldi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle The Wall Street Journal'ın haberine göre ABD Menkul Kıymetler ve Borsa Komisyonu (SEC), şirketin yatırımcılara yaptığı açıklamaların yanıltıcı olup olmadığını incelemek üzere sivil soruşturma başlatıyor. Söz konusu iddia, Nvidia'nın yönetim değişikliği ve Çin'e çip ihracatı tartışmalarıyla gündemde olduğu bir dönemde geldi. Çin'e çip sevkiyatı ve Megaspeed bağlantısı mercek altında Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang, evlilik dışı ilişkilerine ilişkin haberlerin ardından görevinden ayrılmıştı. İddialar arasında, Singapur merkezli veri şirketi Megaspeed'in yöneticisi Alice Huang ile ilişkisi de yer alıyordu. ABD Ticaret Bakanlığı'nın, 2024'ün sonlarından bu yana Megaspeed hakkında soruşturma yürüttüğü belirtiliyor. Şirketin Nvidia çiplerinin bir bölümünü Çin'e yönlendirmiş olabileceği şüphesi araştırılıyor. Böyle bir sevkiyatın ABD ihracat yasalarını ihlal edebileceği ifade ediliyor. ABD Kongresi de Jensen Huang'ın söz konusu ilişki ve bunun Çin'e yönelik çip ihracatı kısıtlamalarının gevşetilmesi yönündeki tutumuna olası etkileri hakkında soruları yanıtlamasını talep etmişti. ABD Hazine Bakanı'ndan Nvidia'ya ağır suçlama ABD Hazine Bakanı Scott Bessent de hafta sonunda Nvidia'ya yönelik sert açıklamalarda bulundu. Bessent, şirketin gelirlerini ve kârını artırmak amacıyla güçlü çipleri Çin'e bilerek sattığını öne sürdü. Bu açıklamalar, Washington yönetiminin Nvidia'nın Çin'e yönelik çip satışlarına ilişkin denetim ve ihracat kısıtlamalarını artırdığı bir dönemde geldi. Nvidia'nın geliri yüzde 103 arttı SEC soruşturması iddiası, Nvidia'nın finansal sonuçlarını açıkladığı gün gündeme geldi. Şirket, mali yılının üçüncü çeyreğinde 115,8 milyar dolar gelir elde etti. Bu rakam, geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre yüzde 103 artışa işaret etti. Buna karşın Nvidia hisseleri, Huang'ın CEO'luk görevinden ayrılmasından bu yana yüzde 10'dan fazla değer kaybetti. Yatırımcılar, şirketin güçlü gelir büyümesinin yanı sıra yönetim değişikliği, Çin'e çip ihracatı ve ABD'deki düzenleyici incelemelerin Nvidia'nın geleceğine etkisini takip ediyor.

articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Announces Agenda for December Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.articleText: Release Number 9327-26 CFTC Announces Agenda for December Roundtable on 24/7 Trading November 17, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today released the agenda for an industry roundtable to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The roundtable is taking place Dec. 15 from 1 to 4 p.m. EST at CFTC Headquarters, Three Lafayette Centre, 1155 21st St., NW, Washington, D.C. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9318-26]. Among other topics, attendees will discuss issues related to the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight and weekend trading, tokenization, margin, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. “From the outset of my chairmanship, I have been clear the CFTC will promote innovation in our derivatives markets in a manner attentive to the nuances of these markets and the varied asset classes that underpin them,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I look forward to hearing directly from industry stakeholders on the ways 24/7 trading would impact their respective business models to ensure the Commission is appropriately tailoring its regulatory regime for all market participants.” View the full agenda here. This meeting is open to the public and will be livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Dial-in information appears below. For the highest quality, select the number nearest your current location. - New York: 646-828-7666 - New Jersey: 551-285-1373 - San Jose: 669-254-5252 or 669-216-1590 - US toll free: 833-568-8864 or 833-435-1820 - US Spanish-language line: 646-964-1167 or 415-449-4000 - International Numbers - Webinar ID: 165 708 9557 - Passcode: 669856 Individuals with additional questions should contact [email protected]. The views, opinions, and information expressed by roundtable participants are solely those of the respective participants and do not necessarily reflect the views of the Commission, its staff, or the U.S. government. -CFTC-

news.summary: ABD'de ham petrol ve yakıt stoklarının yükselmesi, küresel arzın toparlanabileceği beklentileriyle petrol fiyatlarını aşağı çekti. Ham petrolün varil fiyatı aşağı yönlü seyrini sürdürürken, ABD-İran çatışmasının Hürmüz Boğazı'ndaki sevkiyatları tehdit etmesi kayıpları sınırladı.

news.titleTr: Petrolde sınırlı rahatlama: ABD stokları arttı, Hürmüz'deki riskler devam etti
news.summaryTr: ABD'de ham petrol ve yakıt stoklarının yükselmesi, küresel arzın toparlanabileceği beklentileriyle petrol fiyatlarını aşağı çekti. Ham petrolün varil fiyatı aşağı yönlü seyrini sürdürürken, ABD-İran çatışmasının Hürmüz Boğazı'ndaki sevkiyatları tehdit etmesi kayıpları sınırladı.
news.articleText: Petrolde sınırlı rahatlama: ABD stokları arttı, Hürmüz'deki riskler devam etti ABD'de ham petrol ve yakıt stoklarının yükselmesi, küresel arzın toparlanabileceği beklentileriyle petrol fiyatlarını aşağı çekti. Ham petrolün varil fiyatı aşağı yönlü seyrini sürdürürken, ABD-İran çatışmasının Hürmüz Boğazı'ndaki sevkiyatları tehdit etmesi kayıpları sınırladı. Petrol fiyatları aşağı çekildi Petrol fiyatları, ABD'de ham petrol ve yakıt stoklarının geçen hafta arttığını gösteren verilerin ardından düşüşünü sürdürdü. WTI ham petrol vadeli işlemleri TSİ 07.49 itibarıyla yüzde 0,65 gerileyerek varil başına 85,45 dolara indi. Brent petrol vadeli işlemleri de yüzde 0,17 düşüşle 92,98 dolardan işlem gördü. ABD'nin ham petrol ve benzin stokları yükseldi Amerikan Petrol Enstitüsü (API) verilerine göre, 13 Kasım'da sona eren haftada ABD'nin ham petrol stokları 5,28 milyon varil arttı. Aynı dönemde benzin stoklarında 5,12 milyon varil, damıtılmış yakıt stoklarında ise 351 bin varil artış kaydedildi. Yemen'deki İran destekli Husi milisleri, salı günü Suudi Arabistan'ın Doğu-Batı petrol boru hattı üzerindeki iki pompa istasyonuna beş insansız hava aracı fırlattıklarını açıkladı. Suudi Arabistan, savaş sürecinde petrol sevkiyatını Hürmüz Boğazı dışına yönlendirmek amacıyla söz konusu hattı kullanarak ham petrolü Yanbu Limanı'na taşıyor. Keşm adasına saldırı ABD ile İran arasındaki karşılıklı saldırılar ve Hürmüz Boğazı'ndan geçen gemilere yönelik riskler, petrol fiyatlarındaki düşüşü sınırladı. ABD ordusu, İran'ın bölgedeki ABD personeli ve varlıklarına yönelik saldırılarının ardından salı günü Kişm Adası'ndaki bir füze fırlatma üssünü hedef aldı. Üçüncü bir ABD uçak gemisinin Körfez'e ulaşmasıyla İran, ABD güçlerine ve ticari gemilere yönelik tehditlerini artırdı. Bahreyn Savunma Kuvvetleri de çarşamba günü, ABD Donanması Beşinci Filosu'na ev sahipliği yapan ülkeye yönelik İran hava saldırılarının engellendiğini açıkladı. Hürmüz Boğazı'nda tanker saldırıları sürüyor Hürmüz Boğazı'ndaki deniz trafiğine yönelik güvenlik riskleri, petrol sevkiyatında aksama endişelerini artırıyor. Pazartesi günü Umman kıyılarında boğazdan geçiş yapan bir LPG tankerine bir cismin isabet etmesi üzerine mürettebat gemiyi tahliye etmek zorunda kaldı. LSEG analistleri, bölgesel petrol arzının alternatif güzergâhlar üzerinden toparlanabileceğini ancak mevcut gemi verilerinin Hürmüz Boğazı'ndaki sevkiyatın henüz normalleşmediğini gösterdiğini belirtti. İran ile arabulucu ülkeler arasındaki görüşmeler devam ediyor ABD-İran çatışmasının yoğunlaştığı süreçte İran ile arabulucu ülkeler Umman ve Katar arasındaki görüşmeler sürüyor. Karşılıklı saldırıların etkisiyle petrol fiyatları salı gününü yükselişle tamamladı. Hürmüz Boğazı'ndan geçen gemilere yönelik saldırılar da arz güvenliğine ilişkin endişeleri artırdı.

news.titleTr: Altın ve gümüşte zaman tüneli! Fiyat Eylül 2025 seviyesine kadar gitti
news.summaryTr: Altın, güçlü dolar karşısında ezilmeye devam ediyor. Ons altın fiyatı, 22-29 Eylül 2025 haftası seviyelerine kadar geri çekilirken Fed'den gelen şahin açıklamalar baskıyı artırıyor. Yatırımcıların gözü ise bugün açıklanacak Fed tutanaklarında.
news.articleText: Altın ve gümüşte zaman tüneli! Fiyat Eylül 2025 seviyesine kadar gitti Altın, güçlü dolar karşısında ezilmeye devam ediyor. Ons altın fiyatı, 22-29 Eylül 2025 haftası seviyelerine kadar geri çekilirken Fed'den gelen şahin açıklamalar baskıyı artırıyor. Yatırımcıların gözü ise bugün açıklanacak Fed tutanaklarında. Altın bir yıldan uzun sürenin dibine geriledi Altın fiyatları, çarşamba günü doların güçlenmesi ve ABD'de faiz artırımı beklentilerinin etkisiyle sert düşüş kaydetti. Spot altın, TSİ 07.13 itibarıyla yüzde 1,65'in üzerinde değer kaybederek ons başına 3.796,37 dolara geriledi. Böylece değerli metal, Eylül 2025'in 3. haftasından bu yana en düşük seviyesine indi. O tarihte altın, rekor kıracağı yolculukta doğru hızlı yükseliş içindeydi. Güçlü dolar altın ve gümüşü baskıladı ABD doları, 19 ayın en yüksek seviyesine yakın seyrini korudu. Bu durum, faiz getirisi sunan varlıkların cazibesini yükseltirken altın fiyatları üzerindeki baskıyı güçlendiriyor. KCM Trade Baş Piyasa Analisti Tim Waterer, piyasalardaki oynaklık nedeniyle yatırımcıların pozisyonlarını azaltarak sermayeyi başka varlıklara yönlendirdiğini ve altının yeniden bir likidite kaynağı olarak değerlendirildiğini belirtti. Piyasalar Fed tutanaklarına odaklandı Yatırımcılar, Fed'in 27-28 Ekim tarihlerinde gerçekleştirdiği Federal Açık Piyasa Komitesi (FOMC) toplantısının tutanaklarını bekliyor. TSİ 19.00'da yayımlanması beklenen tutanakların, merkez bankasının faiz politikasına ilişkin değerlendirmelerine ve gelecek döneme yönelik yaklaşımına dair ipuçları vermesi bekleniyor. Gram gümüş satış fiyatı 74,47 TL oldu. Gram gümüş, tarihinde ilk kez 28 Kasım 2025 tarihinde 75 TL seviyesini aşmıştı.

news.title: Jeff Bezos says he was 'heavily involved' in casting Robert Pattinson as new 007
news.summary: The Amazon CEO said he was originally "biased against" Pattinson "because he's already so famous".
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Jeff Bezos says he was 'heavily involved' in casting Robert Pattinson as new 007
news.summaryTr: The Amazon CEO said he was originally "biased against" Pattinson "because he's already so famous".
news.articleText: Jeff Bezos says he was 'heavily involved' in casting Robert Pattinson as new 007 - Published Jeff Bezos has said he was "heavily involved" in casting Robert Pattinson as the new James Bond. Speaking at an event in California, the Amazon CEO said he was originally "biased against" Pattinson - who starred in many blockbuster films like Batman and the Twilight series - "because he's already so famous". The role of 007 has typically gone to an actor who is not as well-known at the time of casting. But Bezos said in screen tests, "it was so obvious he is James Bond". This will be the first 007 not under the creative control of the Broccoli family, who had overseen the franchise since the first Bond film in 1962. Amazon purchased MGM, which co-owns the franchise, in 2022. "There was something special about Rob", Bezos said at Semafor Silicon Valley & The World Event on Tuesday. Pattinson was unveiled as the franchise's seventh James Bond on Monday, taking over from actor Daniel Craig. He will star in the 26th Bond movie, due to be released in 2028. In a statement, the London-born actor said: "James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honour of a lifetime." The next Bond film will be directed by Denis Villeneuve, but its title and exact release date have not yet been announced. The announcement comes after years of intense speculation about who will take over from Craig in one of the most high-profile - and highly scrutinised - roles in entertainment. Several other actors, including Josh O'Connor, Callum Turner and Jack Lowden, were reported to be in the frame for the role as screen tests took place in recent weeks. But Amazon MGM ultimately went with a household name, choosing a more bankable movie star who is widely seen as a safe pair of hands. "We ran a really tight process and made the final decision on Friday," Bezos said. There were five finalists who went through "real, old-fashioned screen tests", acting out three different scenes in full costume, with real sets and other actors, he said. "By the time we got to this list of five, they were all amazing. But there was something special about Rob and his performance," Bezos added. "It was immediately un-debated. Denis [Villeneuve], the director … we all gravitated toward Rob." The pick comes amid widespread Hollywood cuts and consolidation, with studios struggling to get people into cinemas. Hollywood insiders have said Pattinson was viewed as a safe pick to bring audiences in, rather than taking a risk on a new actor who could grow with the franchise. "Maybe he's boring. Maybe Hollywood would be passing up a chance to anoint a badly needed new star. But with so much at stake for everyone involved, that all makes him the obvious pick," Hollywood journalist Matthew Belloni, who predicted the pick, wrote in his newsletter. The BBC's Regan Morris contributed to this report. Related topics - Published15 hours ago - Published12 hours ago

news.titleTr: Waymo pulls driverless taxis from all US freeways
news.summaryTr: The decision comes after California banned Waymo's driverless vehicles from operating on the state's highways following a series of traffic incidents.
news.articleText: Waymo pulls driverless taxis from all US freeways - Published Waymo has temporarily suspended its driverless vehicles from operating on all US freeways, the company has said. The decision comes after California banned Waymo's driverless taxis from state freeways following a series of recent traffic incidents. California's Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) cited an "imminent hazard to public safety" for the ban, noting an incident this month in which several driverless Waymo vehicles entered an active construction zone on US Route 101. Waymo said it was working with state officials "diligently and responsibly to resume freeway operations", adding that no injuries or collisions were reported following the incident on US Route 101 south of San Francisco. California's DMV said Waymo's driverless taxis presented a risk "due to recurring incursions by its vehicles into active construction zones where construction workers, vehicles and equipment are present". In another incident earlier this month, footage widely seen on social media appeared to show a Waymo car trying to overtake patrol vehicles that were deliberately slowing the pace of traffic on a San Francisco highway. The California ban, which came into effect on 11 November, would remain in place until Waymo "demonstrates to the department that it has taken effective corrective actions to address the deficiencies that precipitated the restrictions". A Waymo spokesperson said: "In alignment with our safety-first principles, we have also temporarily restricted freeway operations across our other operating markets to evaluate our performance." Data on Waymo's website suggests that its cars, compared to human drivers, are involved in 95% fewer crashes resulting in serious injury. Waymo currently operates driverless taxis in 15 US cities, but only offered freeway rides in a handful of those locations, including San Francisco, Los Angeles and Miami. The company's driverless taxis can continue to operate on regular city streets. In May, Waymo recalled thousands of its self-driving cars in the US over a software issue that could allow vehicles to drive into flooded roads. In the same month, multiple Waymo cars were spotted driving around a cul-de-sac in Atlanta, Georgia, in the early hours of the morning. Related topics - Published19 June

news.title: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as firm reports bumper results
news.summary: The AI chip giant reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday after the dramatic exit of Jensen Huang.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as firm reports bumper results
news.summaryTr: The AI chip giant reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday after the dramatic exit of Jensen Huang.
news.articleText: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as firm reports bumper results - Published Nvidia's quarterly sales doubled to top $100bn for the first time as the company insisted it has no plans to reinstate ousted co-founder Jensen Huang. In the company's first results since Huang's dramatic exit, interim chief executive Colette Kress said it is "business as usual" and told investors: "We've got this." The company's quarterly sales doubled from a year earlier, reaching $115.8bn (£86.9bn), with shares in the company jumping by 4.8% in after-hours trading. Earlier on Tuesday, Huang said he would be "honoured" to return and lead Nvidia, having quit following alleged extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected spy for China. "The board does not intend to reinstate him," Nvidia chair Harvey Jones said during a call on Tuesday with financial analysts. The company's profits also doubled from a year ago. For the quarter, which covered the three months to 25 October, profit hit $65bn. Its revenue from data centres, a significant part of Nvidia's business, also doubled to $107bn in the same period. Going forward, the company said its rapid growth is poised to continue, and revenue will rise by another 13% in the next quarter. Given the uncertainty surrounding the company after Huang's exit, financial analysts had been unsure that Nvidia would provide any forward-looking guidance. Daniela Hathorn, a senior analyst for trading platform Capital.com, said Nvidia's results "offer a strong answer to concerns that demand for AI infrastructure is cooling" and temper immediate worries that Huang was irreplaceable as a leader. "The harder question is whether Nvidia can preserve the strategic advantage Huang helped build," Hathorn added. "His exit is unlikely to change orders already committed, but could matter more when Nvidia makes its next round of decisions on products, partnerships and investment." Kress seemed eager to stress that Nvidia can continue to not only succeed, but lead the ongoing AI buildout that is happening throughout the technology industry. "It is business as usual," she said. "Our partners, our suppliers, all of them are 100% behind us." She added that Nvidia's leadership team has "stood up very strongly over the last week... working seamlessly in all of their departments and projects". "Our momentum is real. Our demand is accelerating. Our supply is growing. Our customers and our partners are with us, and employees are committed." Kress said before leaving the analyst call. "We've got this." The interim CEO also said Nvidia is no longer shipping Hopper data centre semiconductors to China. The Hopper technology is in Nvidia's advanced H200 processors, which the firm won approval to sell in China after Huang's repeated lobbying efforts in Washington. They had previously been restricted over concerns that selling them to China would give its industries and military an edge over the US. Kress did not elaborate on why the shipments had been stopped. Despite board chairman Jones saying earlier that the company would not answer analysts' questions about Huang or Nvidia's investigation into his conduct, he did address the search for a permanent replacement. He said Nvidia is working with an executive search firm and is considering internal and external candidates, but that the company would not rush its selection. "With the advanced technology and the national security dynamics in the marketplace, our new CEO will have to navigate those waters carefully," Jones said. "The search will be thorough and we want to do it as quickly as possible, but we won't do it before we find the exact right person." Michael Monaghan from investment firm Founder ETFs is among those who want Huang back in the top job at Nvidia. The Nvidia investor told the BBC that he is waiting to see the results of a thorough investigation into Huang's actions, instead of relying on "salacious allegations" made in the media. Nvidia's strong earnings are "from the machine that Jensen built" and a company tends to lose "its shine and vision" after an iconic founder leaves, Monaghan said. news.title: Europe plans to catch the next computer chip wave
news.summary: Europe hopes to be a leader in a new generation of computer chips which use light to process data.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Europe plans to catch the next computer chip wave
news.summaryTr: Europe hopes to be a leader in a new generation of computer chips which use light to process data.
news.articleText: Europe plans to catch the next computer chip wave - Published "Photonic chips are on the verge of a breakthrough," says Ton van Mol of the Dutch research institute TNO. If van Mol is right – and TNO, the European Union and the Dutch government are backing the idea with millions of euros - then the technology could be a gamechanger. The chips which run today's society, from your phone and TV, to the vast data centres meeting our insatiable desire for AI, are mostly electrical. They process data by shunting electrons around tiny circuits – a single microchip produced today can contain billions of transistors, and sizes are measured in nanometres (one nanometre is a billionth of a metre). Because they use light instead of electricity, photonic chips are faster, use less energy and generate less heat than traditional computer chips. Van Mol hopes for an acceleration in photonics similar to the one seen in electrical chips since the 1970s. "With optical chips, you are now where electronic chips were maybe 40 [or] 50 years ago." American, Taiwanese and Chinese firms dominate the computer chip industry, but Europe sees the emergence of photonic chips as a fresh opportunity to lead, on what could be, a key future technology. Which is why the European Union has committed €400m ($450m; £330m) to a project called PIX Europe, external, with the stated goal of making the continent "a global leader in emerging technology for Photonic Integrated Chips". "Europe said 'we need to have our own manufacturing in-house'," says van Mol, who is leading a key part of the programme. "We cannot depend like in the past that everything is manufactured in the US or China - that's not wise, so the [European] Chips Act was called into life, and one of the parts of the act is to build pilot lines to really bring the technology, which is now in labs, to the next stage - manufacturing." 'Really serious' development Electronic and photonic chips are produced on wafers made up of hundreds of individual chips. Factories with machines that can handle bigger wafers can churn out chips more efficiently. "[Photonic chip] manufacturing worldwide is [currently] done on wafers which are four inches (10cm) in size, and the next step is to scale-up production to a six-inch wafer," says van Mol. His team are already building a 10,000 sq m factory to produce six-inch indium phosphide wafers on the High Tech Campus in the Dutch city of Eindhoven. It's due to fully open in 2030 and will be a major step forward, not just for photonics in Europe, but around the world, according to van Mol. "That's the development TNO is going to do, in a pilot line which is really serious. "In 2030, we hope that we have a stable, reproducible, high-yield process, and then the intention is that the pilot line [opens] to industrial parties who can make commercial production out of it." Europe does have one crucial player in the current computer chip industry - ASML. The Netherlands-based tech giant is the only company in the world able to build the machines needed to make the most sophisticated semiconductors. Which is why ASML products will sit at the heart of the pilot line in Eindhoven - it's no coincidence that van Mol's project is based around the corner from ASML's headquarters. "The way you produce these [photonic] chips is very similar to the way you produce electrical or electronic chip," says van Mol. "You use the same type of equipment, you also need a high-end clean room, you also use wafers, so the production method is very similar to the traditional semiconductor technology." ASML itself is keen to explore the opportunities that the emerging technology of photonics could offer. "Europe has a strong position in photonics research. The next challenge is translating those innovations into industrial-scale manufacturing," says Stanislas Baron, who is the head of ASML's EU/US Customer Team. ASML's unique success has helped build an influential and lucrative network of companies and institutions devoted to semiconductor technology in and around Eindhoven, and it's a model for what Europe is trying to achieve with photonic chips. The Eindhoven project has the backing of former ASML chief executive Peter Wennink, author of an influential report for the Dutch government called The Roadmap to Future Prosperity, external, which noted that the market for photonics was expected to grow 10 to 20 times in the next 10 years. In a news release backing the new pilot line, Wennink described it as "a launchpad for Europe's future digital economy". "By investing in scalable production capacity, we are creating an ecosystem that can help shape the global technological direction," he said. Of course, Europe is not alone in looking to the potential of photonics to earn a global economic advantage. In June this year, US photonics company Coherent, external announced what it called "the world's first and largest volume-production six-inch indium phosphide manufacturing platform" at its plant in Sherman, in Texas. The expansion is backed by chip manufacturing giant Nvidia, as well as $50 million public funds under the US Chips Act. It's an illustration of how quickly the market is moving, and how central photonic chips could be to the continuing race to retain an influential stake in AI and technological development more generally. Europe's bid to establish itself as a global leader in photonic chips – exemplified by the Eindhoven project – is the kind of strategy that makes sense in a globalised economy, says Joris Teer, policy analyst at the European Institute for Security Studies in Brussels. If the continent can take a lead in photonic chips, then future developments in AI and data will partly be dependent on Europe. "Europe knows that its high energy and labour costs, skilled workforce shortages, and lack of private and public capital make an across-the-board reindustrialisation strategy impossible", Teer says. "To retain influence, ensuring dependence on European parties rather than European autonomy is key." Once up and running, the Eindhoven project will provide a pilot production line which can be used multiple companies. It will be open to businesses across Europe and beyond, who can design and build chips without having to develop their own expensive production facilities. "What we want to establish here is what we call a foundry model; there's no intention to have our own product," Ton van Mol says. Instead, they will produce to order for outside customers. It's the same idea which, at huge scale, has brought Taiwanese-based giant TSMC a position of global dominance in the manufacture of microchips. Photonic chips are already in use, in highly specialised areas in data centres and in Lidar (light detection and ranging) sensor technology, for instance. For van Mol of TNO, helping the industry to scale up, by easing production challenges and increasing capacity, is the key step to moving them into the tech we use in our daily lives, like phones and laptops, and to drive innovation in areas like medical scanners and 6G communications. "The demand is there", says van Mol, "and the end goal is to have, in Europe, manufacturing of these chips, which is strategically very important because these chips [could] become the backbone of all data and telecom." It's the same idea which, at huge scale, has brought Taiwanese-based giant TSMC a position of global dominance in the manufacture of microchips. Photonic chips are already in use, in highly specialised areas in data centres and in Lidar (light detection and ranging) sensor technology, for instance. For van Mol of TNO, helping the industry to scale up, by easing production challenges and increasing capacity, is the key step to moving them into the tech we use in our daily lives, like phones and laptops, and to drive innovation in areas like medical scanners and 6G communications. "The demand is there", says van Mol, "and the end goal is to have, in Europe, manufacturing of these chips, which is strategically very important because these chips [could] become the backbone of all data and telecom." news.articleText: Adil Katılım Bankası'nın faaliyet izni iptal edildi: Temettü dışındaki haklar TMSF'ye devredildi YAYIN TARİHİ, 18 Kasım 2026 02:06 PAYLAŞ - Bankacılık Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurulu, Adil Katılım Bankası A.Ş.'nin temettü dışındaki ortaklık hakları ile yönetim ve denetimini Tasarruf Mevduatı Sigorta Fonu'na devretti. Karar 18 Kasım tarihli Resmî Gazete'de yayımlandı. Bankacılık Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurulu (BDDK), Adil Katılım Bankası A.Ş. hakkında karar aldı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 18 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmî Gazete'de yayımlanan 11601 sayılı Kurul Kararı'na göre bankanın temettü dışındaki ortaklık hakları ile yönetim ve denetimi Tasarruf Mevduatı Sigorta Fonu'na (TMSF) devredildi. Karar, BDDK'nın 17 Kasım 2026 tarihli toplantısında yapılan inceleme ve değerlendirmelerin ardından alındı. Karar Bankacılık Kanunu'na dayandırıldı Kurul kararında, Adil Katılım Bankası'nın temettü dışındaki ortaklık hakları ile yönetim ve denetiminin 5411 sayılı Bankacılık Kanunu'nun 71'inci maddesinin birinci fıkrasının (a), (c) ve (d) bentleri kapsamında TMSF'ye devredilmesine hükmedildi. Karar, 18 Kasım 2026 tarihinde yayımlanarak duyuruldu.
